title: The Last Guy You Want to Arrest

On February 12, 2023, La Crosse police officers responded to a disturbance complaint involving a male who yelled at a driver and damaged his vehicle. The male was immediately identified, and he was known for his long history of criminal activities. When the officers informed him of his impending arrest, he showed no intention of surrendering easily.
